flow: Regional logistics operator shifted from Excel-based route planning to AI routing. Freed planners for exception management and lifted fleet utilization.
Planners built routes manually every morning at 5am. Fleet utilization capped around 68%. As volume grew, planners couldn't keep up, and overtime costs started eating margins.

Deployed Trackeys Delivery & Routing with multi-factor AI optimization: time-windows, vehicle constraints, driver hours, and live traffic. Planners shifted from building routes to reviewing exceptions.
